Sam (AE): Quick sync for Acme POC — Lina wants a 3-week trial for an embed-led FAQ + document redaction flow. Main asks: measurable success criteria, cost for a temporary Dedicated burst, and answers on data handling.
Lina (AcmePOC): Correct. Key metric for us is user-facing correctness (we'll call it 'Helpfulness') on a curated golden questions set. Also need proof redaction never logs raw PII.
Priya (SolutionsEng): Proposal: build a 400-sample golden set from their top-traffic support threads + 4 paraphrases each -> ~1600 eval prompts. Scoring: binary answer correctness + hallucination indicator + normalized format pass.
Priya (SolutionsEng): Suggested scoring weights: correctness 0.7, hallucination penalty 0.2, format 0.1. We'll compute a weighted score and require >=0.80 for pass.
Carlos (Pricing): For Dedicated burst during load tests: we can offer a trial pricing sheet: flat one-time test fee + metered burst at X$/hour. If they want budget certainty, offer a 10-day capped commit at reduced effective rate.
Omar (Security): On data handling: we require sanitized input for the eval harness. We can accept sanitized transcripts or run our in-house redaction. We will not accept raw logs. Also need their KMS ARN if they insist on customer-managed keys.
Lina (AcmePOC): We can provide 250 real examples sanitized by our team, but need your scrubbing rules to match compliance. Also want to understand regression policy: what happens if an OTA model update causes a drop?
Priya (SolutionsEng): Regression guardrails: enforce two gates — automated and human. Automated gate: if weighted score drops >2.5% vs baseline OR hallucination count increases by >4% -> fail. On fail, auto-route traffic to the previous model variant for the POC route and open a human review ticket.
Priya (SolutionsEng): We'll include a small pytest-based harness that: ingests a CSV of (prompt, expected_answer, intent), runs model variants, computes metrics, and emits a regression report. Example config snippet: ```
[scoring]
weights = {"correctness":0.7, "hallucination":0.2, "format":0.1}
regression_threshold = -0.025
```
Sam (AE): Lina — can you confirm traffic peaks (time windows) and preferred test days so we can schedule Dedicated burst?
Lina (AcmePOC): Peak windows are weekdays 10:00-11:30 ET and 16:00-16:30 ET. For load tests we want two 20-min stress windows on different days. Expect ~180 RPS sustained during peak, +/- 20.
Carlos (Pricing): Noted. I'll draft a one-page pricing appendix with burst pricing and an optional 10-day commitment discount. Legal will need the appendix to reference a trial clause.
Omar (Security): One more: auditability. For any eval request we store a trace id, model version, prompt hash, and anonymized metadata. No raw input retained in logs. We'll provide a hashing procedure for verification.
Priya (SolutionsEng): Actions: 1) I'll drop the eval harness link + sample scoring config (today). 2) Lina -> supply sanitized sample CSV (EOD). 3) Omar -> share redaction checklist and hashing procedure (48h). 4) Carlos -> pricing appendix draft (tomorrow). 5) Sam -> SOW draft and milestone calendar.
infra-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: sales-poc-canary at 2024-12-02T15:30:00Z.
Sam (AE): Anything blocking from the customer side? Lina?
Lina (AcmePOC): Need our compliance team to OK the scrubbing rules. I'll coordinate and send contact. Also will deliver KMS ARN via secure channel to Omar.
Priya (SolutionsEng): We'll include a short demo notebook to show sanitization -> ingest -> eval flow so your compliance team can review.
Sam (AE): Great, I'll follow up with a short recap email and attach the SOW draft when ready. Thanks all. :rocket:
